name: gemini-search-mcp
description: MCP server that performs Google Search via Gemini grounding

scripts.inspect: npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/inspector ${GEMINI_API_KEY:+-e GEMINI_API_KEY=$GEMINI_API_KEY} ${GEMINI_PROVIDER:+-e GEMINI_PROVIDER=$GEMINI_PROVIDER} ${VERTEX_PROJECT_ID:+-e VERTEX_PROJECT_ID=$VERTEX_PROJECT_ID} ${VERTEX_LOCATION:+-e VERTEX_LOCATION=$VERTEX_LOCATION} ${GEMINI_MODEL:+-e GEMINI_MODEL=$GEMINI_MODEL} ${GEMINI_TIMEOUT_MS:+-e GEMINI_TIMEOUT_MS=$GEMINI_TIMEOUT_MS} ${RESOLVE_SOURCE_URLS:+-e RESOLVE_SOURCE_URLS=$RESOLVE_SOURCE_URLS} node dist/index.js
